general.title: UK Gilts Look 'Attractive,' Allspring Says
general.summary: Lauren van Biljon, Allspring Global Investments senior rates and FX portfolio manager, says UK gilts are "attractive." She also adds the Bank of England will likely hike interest rates again but "probably not until next year." Van Biljon speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Why you should expect an AI crash - The Economist
Italy’s Poste Targets €600 Million Fund Amid AI Data Center Boom
general.summary: Poste Italiane SpA launched a co-investment fund targeting €600 million ($665 million) for projects including data centers, expanding its digital infrastructure ambitions following the takeover of Telecom Italia SpA.

general.title: Ukrainian defense tech startup hits $6 billion valuation as investors bet on battle-tested drones
general.summary: UFORCE's NEMESIS drones have completed 300,000 combat flights, and its MAGURA naval vessels have contributed to the destruction of Russian warships.

general.title: Most large firms plan higher open-weight AI use to cap bills, study shows - Reuters
Dubai Tycoon Expects Billions From Anthropic, AI Investments
general.summary: Dubai tycoon Hussain Sajwani expects his investments in artificial intelligence firms including Anthropic PBC to draw billions in returns, highlighting the wins some investors are racking up from putting in money into the technology giants in recent years.

general.title: Blackstone, Pimco Target Gulf’s Multibillion-Dollar Buildout
general.summary: Some of the world’s biggest investment firms are looking to deploy more capital across the Middle East just as governments open more infrastructure projects to outside investors.

general.title: AI is coming for consulting’s billable hours — and its graduate pipeline
general.summary: AI is changing the consulting industry, forcing firms to rethink billable hours and the traditional graduate career ladder.

general.title: Turkey Raises Inflation Forecasts on War, Fund-Rout Effects
general.summary: Turkey’s central bank raised its inflation forecasts through the end of next year, citing ongoing pressures from the Iran war and market volatility caused by a major national fund scandal.
